title: Parseval identity for the uniform norm
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The uniform $2$-norm of $f$ equals the $2$-norm of its Fourier spectrum, the vector of Fourier coefficients indexed by $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$.
